title: Junior Civil Engineer - Melbourne VIC
content_text: Commit to people, change, and the environment by beginning your career with Senversa! Senversa Pty Ltd is an Australian employee-owned environmental consulting firm with offices in Melbourne, Geelong, Sydney, Newcastle, Adelaide, Perth, and Brisbane . We are committed to delivering high quality environmental advice to our clients while providing a supportive environment for our staff. Our Civil & Environmental Engineering Team delivers innovative and integrated engineering solutions for the waste, resources and renewables industries from project conception through construction of waste containment, soil, and water storage/retention projects nationwide. Our team specialise in geosynthetic solutions across a range of applications, chasing the atypical and technically challenging projects to exceed our clients’ expectations and deliver a solution fit for future generations to come. We have an exciting opportunity for a passionate Graduate or junior career professional, to work as a part of our National Engineering team based in Melbourne, VIC. who have a passion for delivery excellence, providing you with exposure to a some of the most exciting and challenging projects ground engineering has to offer in a range of industry sectors. The role presents a great opportunity to grow and enable you to shape your future with direct inhouse support from our industry leading staff, who have a proven track record of delivering high quality, strategic and commercially astute professional services to federal, state, and local government entities, together with large multi-national private and public companies. In this role, you will gain exposure to a diverse range of projects including: Geosynthetic containment and capping designs in waste, resource and renewables industries Landfill design and advisory support Superintendency, Contract Management and Construction Support Project feasibility studies If you want to unlock your potential in the environmental and sustainability industry, Senversa is the place for you. Does this sound like you? In your final year of university in a course related to Environmental or Civil Engineering, or a related field, or have up to 2 years of experience Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Bring a wealth of energy, enthusiasm, and a thirst for knowledge in the workplace. Hold a valid Australian driver’s licence. At Senversa you will have the opportunity to develop your skills as a consultant, learning from the most-experienced and revered teams, and gaining valuable knowledge in the environmental and geosynthetic field. We offer extensive opportunities for Graduate training and development nation-wide, and pride ourselves on promoting a collaborative working environment that truly puts our people and culture first. YOU are the future leaders of our business and communities. We are dedicated to investing in your development and providing you with the tools and resources necessary for your career to thrive. If you are interested in these exciting opportunities and meet the above criteria, please submit your CV and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you.
apply_instructions: Apply on Senversa's BambooHR careers page with CV and cover letter.
